_about: The studio's path to every licence and terms page it relies on for AI-generated content: the page, the exact clause, its date, and R&D's verdict per use. Uses: assets (shipping output commercially), training (output as training data), evaluation (output in tests or controls), code (AI-written code in studio tools). Verdicts: proven, conditions (proven with the conditions listed), barred, not_proven, n/a. snapshot_sha256 is the sha256 of the page text as fetched on read_date; full-text snapshots are kept off the repo (see README). This is a reading of published terms, not legal advice.

On Ollama, gemma4:31b serves two variants that both bundle the unmodified Apache-2.0 text: llamacpp (manifest sha256 17ba34c06c801ba22f6047bab21ced9429c6d43e0e42ecf339b0f3e5a61e8d97, 20 GB Q4_K_M weights layer cd20f2b3f2e3, projector 6357a8a2d521, licence layer 7339fa418c9a) and mlx (manifest 92808281a855, licence layer a59e1ee2d202). Relation to apache-2.0 and gemma-prohibited-use-policy: https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms (last modified 2026-04-01) states that the Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy apply to the models in its Appendix (Gemma 1-3) and directs Gemma 4 to the Gemma 4 license (plain Apache-2.0), and neither the card nor the Ollama tag references gemma-prohibited-use-policy. Re-read gemma-prohibited-use-policy (last modified 2024-02-21) in full on 2026-10-29: even if it applied, no clause in it bears on or restricts an evaluation that asks the model questions about fictional people's perceptions and beliefs (its Section 3 privacy clause applies only to sensitive personal or private information about real individuals without required legal consent, and Section 4 deception clauses apply to impersonating living or dead individuals to deceive).

entries.notes: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE model (30B total, 3.5B active). Not gated. By contrast, the Ollama tag nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b does not bundle OpenMDW-1.1: its llamacpp variant (manifest sha256 e6905fffe2e2d9bbe325a9a2d2e074e3bd32683721bc6dfba409dede2f17f4dc, 25 GB Q4_K_M weights layer 5c19f6282f4f) bundles the NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement dated October 24, 2025 (licence blob 215a3316f0f1, 10,084 bytes; existing entry nvidia-open-model-license, whose covers is extended here), and its mlx variant (manifest 29a422b3cf50) bundles the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement dated April 2, 2026 (blob de0520fe3613). Under both openmdw-1.1 and nvidia-open-model-license, evaluation and outputs are unrestricted.

entries.notes: MoE 30B-A3B vision-language model, used as the second local VLM judge. On Ollama, qwen3-vl:30b has the exact same manifest digest as qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-thinking (sha256 eda0be1008774ea4e575187712b9a3b1201f3e66e7ecff899cc295db1cf00248, 20 GB Q4_K_M weights layer b1da6f96a2e4, renderer qwen3-vl-thinking, parser qwen3-thinking), so qwen3-vl:30b serves the Thinking checkpoint (Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking, read here at commit d0ed0380729be07a546fdefafbb4fe411f341e92). The separate instruct tag qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-instruct has manifest digest 9b053ed92b6a3f0b906f4808f1e37bf8bda3708b9ebf55744711772890357c0d (20 GB Q4_K_M weights layer 884457e79121, clip projector 04d9a35e6bb6) corresponding to Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct (also read on 2026-10-29 at commit 9c4b90e1e4ba969fd3b5378b57d966d725f1b86c). Both HF cards are ungated and declare license: apache-2.0 in their front matter (no separate LICENSE file in either repo), and both Ollama tags bundle the identical licence layer 7339fa418c9a (11,358 bytes, unmodified Apache License 2.0 text, apache-2.0).
